tagline: Six forest villas on the edge of Volcanoes National Park.
description:
Bisate Lodge, also presented as Wilderness Bisate, sits on the edge of Volcanoes National Park in northwest Rwanda, in its own concession beside the park boundary. Wilderness opened it in 2017. Six forest villas are circular and built to suggest giant birds' nests, using natural materials and referring to ihumure, the architecture of Rwandan royal compounds. The published coordinates place the lodge at Kinigi. Kigali International Airport (KGL) is about a three-hour drive via Musanze. Wilderness Air does not fly into the park. Road transfers are run by Wilderness Touring, operating as Thousand Hills Rwanda, and helicopter transfers are also offered.

Each villa has a fireplace, a king bed and an en suite. Shared rooms include a wine cellar, a library, a restaurant and The Sanctuary spa. The Kwanda day lounge, in the organic garden, is described as the first of its kind in Rwanda and is there for a late departure after a trek. Views from the lodge take in Mount Bisoke, Karisimbi and Mikeno. The lodge is open year-round. Wilderness suggests a stay of three or four nights. Dry seasons are June to September and December to February. Children under 15 are not permitted on gorilla treks under park rules. The lodge itself is not reserved for adults.

Guests are assigned to one of 12 habituated gorilla groups, with a 60-minute sighting. Golden monkey trekking is offered on the same trails. The Albertine Rift forest around the lodge supports more than 200 bird species. The park holds hundreds of the world's mountain gorillas, along with golden monkeys, bushbuck, buffalo and, at times, elephant. The concession records 120,000 trees planted.

Rates are fully inclusive: accommodation, all meals, local drinks except reserve wines and champagne, laundry, a 3 percent tourism tax, and lodge activities such as nature walks, birding, tree planting, community visits, biodiversity briefings and The Sanctuary. A conservation levy, park fees and gorilla permits are extra. Permits are currently USD 1,500 per person.

Bisate suits travellers who want a small lodge of six villas for gorilla trekking, with meals and most drinks included and the park a short distance from the door.
